# lcd.drawRectangle

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Draw a rectangle.

```lua
lcd.drawRectangle(x, y, w, h[, thickness])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | number | yes | X coordinate |
| `y` | number | yes | Y coordinate |
| `w` | number | yes | rectangle width |
| `h` | number | yes | rectangle height |
| `thickness` | integer | optional (default `1`) | the thickness of the rectangle frame |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua
lcd.drawRectangle(10, 10, 100, 40)        -- 1 px outline
lcd.drawRectangle(10, 60, 100, 40, 3)     -- 3 px thick outline

-- highlight the focused element
if lcd.hasFocus() then
  lcd.color(lcd.themeColor(THEME_FOCUS_COLOR))
  lcd.drawRectangle(0, 0, w, h, 2)
end
```
